comment: Initial load counts the app entry and every transitive static JavaScript import, plus CSS. Lazy counts chunks reached only by dynamic imports, including the terminal, passkey credential helpers and account settings. The previous check counted static shared chunks as lazy and missed them from initial, so these caps match the built asset graph. Sizes are bytes; gzip level 9 approximates a compressing proxy. The UX status skeleton adds under 200 raw bytes and reduced the latest five-run Pixel 4 CLS max from 0.409 to 0.000. Deferring account settings and passkey helpers keeps initial JavaScript under its existing caps. Passkey IP-origin detection and unavailable-address guidance measured 361138 raw lazy JS. API-009 worker-bound token selection adds account settings code; the current lazy bundle measures 365652 raw/96411 gzip, so the caps are 366000/97000. SEC2-014's new-device sign-in notice and immediate refresh after password or passkey login measure 31406 initial JS gzip bytes versus 31000 before; the cap is raised to 31500 while total initial gzip remains below 40000.
